critical.issue: Image-only post path: frontend NewPostBox sends content='📷' (single codepoint, len=1) when textarea empty + image attached, but Pydantic POST_MIN_LEN=4 returns 422 'String should have at least 4 characters'. Either reduce min_length conditionally when image_url is present, or change the frontend placeholder to 4 chars (e.g. '📷 . ').

integration_issues.issue: Frontend sends 'content: content.trim() || "📷"' but backend rejects with 422. User sees 'String should have at least 4 characters' toast and image is lost. See ComunidadPage.jsx line 125.

action_items: Fix image-only post: either change ComunidadPage.jsx line 125 to a 4-char placeholder (e.g., '📷.  ' or 'foto') OR change backend POST_MIN_LEN handling to allow short content when image_url present.
(Optional) Add data-testid hooks on toast messages to make file validation toasts assertable from Playwright.

rca_of_the_issue: Image-only post bug RCA: ComunidadPage.jsx submitPost(): body = { content: content.trim() || '📷', image_url }. Backend NewPostIn requires content min_length=4. Python str length of single emoji '📷' (U+1F4F7) is 1, not 4 (this is correct Python behavior for BMP+SMP codepoints). Pydantic min_length validates against len(str). Result: 422 from backend whenever user uploads image without typing text. Mitigation options: (A) change frontend default to 'foto' or '📷 .' (4 chars), (B) backend: relax min_length when image_url present, (C) override min_length to 1 if NewPostIn migrates to model_validator. Recommended: (A) — simplest, no API contract change.
